subject: Biology
title: Plant Growth and Development
summary: Growth size mein irreversible permanent badhat hai. Plants mein ye indeterminate (open) hai kyunki meristems divide hote rehte hain. Iske teen phases hain — meristematic, elongation aur maturation — aur ye sigmoid curve follow karti hai.

Growth rate arithmetic (ek daughter cell divide hota rehta hai) ya geometric (dono daughter cells divide) ho sakti hai; differentiation, dedifferentiation aur redifferentiation plant ko shape dete hain.
Paanch plant growth regulators growth control karte hain: auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin (promoters), abscisic acid aur ethylene (mainly inhibitors).
Development ko photoperiodism (din ki lambai) aur vernalisation (kam temperature) flowering ke liye, aur seed dormancy aur germination bhi control karte hain.

formulas.name: Arithmetic growth
formulas.when: Linear growth — root constant rate se lambi hoti hai.
formulas.note: Length vs time plot karne par seedhi line aati hai.

formulas.name: Geometric growth
formulas.formula: Wₜ = W₀ eʳᵗ  (r = relative growth rate, e = 2.718)
formulas.when: Growth ka exponential phase (Wₜ final size, W₀ initial size).

formulas.name: Absolute vs relative growth
formulas.formula: absolute = growth per unit time;  relative = growth per unit time per unit initial size
formulas.when: Alag leaves ki growth compare karna.

formulas.name: Sigmoid growth curve
formulas.formula: lag phase → log (exponential) phase → stationary phase
formulas.when: Limited environment mein cells, organs ya organisms ki growth.

formulas.name: Auxins
formulas.formula: IAA, IBA (natural); NAA, 2,4-D (synthetic);  apical dominance, rooting of cuttings, parthenocarpy (tomato), prevent premature leaf and fruit drop, xylem differentiation;  2,4-D kills dicot weeds
formulas.when: Auxin ke kaam (F.W. Went, Avena coleoptile tips se).

formulas.name: Gibberellins
formulas.formula: GA₃ most common (from Gibberella fujikuroi — bakanae disease of rice);  stem elongation (sugarcane yield up by ~20 t/acre), bolting in cabbage/beet, fruit size (grapes), malting (brewing), seed germination, delay fruit senescence (fruits can stay on the tree longer — longer market period)

formulas.name: Cytokinins
formulas.formula: kinetin (from autoclaved herring sperm DNA), zeatin (corn kernels, coconut milk);  cell division, new leaves and chloroplasts, lateral shoot growth (overcomes apical dominance), promote nutrient mobilisation, which delays leaf senescence (Richmond–Lang effect)
formulas.note: Trap: 'nutrient mobilisation se leaf senescence der se' = cytokinin; GA fruit senescence der se karta hai.

formulas.name: Ethylene
formulas.formula: gaseous; ripening of fruits (climacteric rise in respiration), triple response in seedlings, horizontal growth, abscission, flowering in pineapple, breaks dormancy;  ethephon releases ethylene
formulas.note: Agriculture mein sabse zyada use hone wala PGR ethylene hai.

formulas.name: Abscisic acid (ABA)
formulas.formula: stress hormone;  closes stomata, induces dormancy in seeds and buds, promotes abscission;  antagonist of GA

formulas.name: Photoperiodism
formulas.formula: short-day plants flower when days are shorter than a critical length (actually need a long uninterrupted dark period);  long-day plants flower when days are longer;  day-neutral plants are unaffected;  leaves perceive the light
formulas.when: Din ki lambai se flowering ka control (Garner aur Allard).

formulas.name: Vernalisation
formulas.formula: cold treatment needed to promote flowering in some plants — winter wheat, biennials (carrot, sugarbeet, cabbage)
formulas.when: Kam temperature se flowering ka control.

formulas.name: Seed dormancy
formulas.formula: caused by hard seed coat, chemical inhibitors (ABA, phenolics) or immature embryo;  broken by scarification, GA₃, nitrates, chilling

examples.title: Geometric growth
examples.problem: 5 g ka seedling relative growth rate r = 0.1 per day se badhta hai. 10 din baad mass (Wₜ = W₀eʳᵗ)?

examples.title: Relative growth
examples.problem: Ek leaf 10 cm² se 15 cm² ho gayi. Relative growth (%)?

examples.title: Bolting
examples.problem: Cabbage mein bolting kaunsa hormone karata hai, aur bolting kya hai?
examples.solution: Gibberellin. Bolting = cabbage aur beet jaise rosette plants mein flowering se theek pehle internodes ka tezi se lamba hona.

examples.title: Apical dominance
examples.problem: Shoot tip hatane se plant ghana (bushy) kyun ho jaata hai?
examples.solution: Apical bud auxin banata hai jo lateral buds ko dabaata hai (apical dominance). Ise hatane (decapitation) se lateral buds badhte hain — tea plantations aur hedge banane mein use.

examples.title: Stress hormone
examples.problem: ABA ko stress hormone kyun kehte hain?
examples.solution: Ye plant ki stress sehne ki kshamata badhaata hai — paani ki kami mein stomata band karta, bure season se bachne ke liye dormancy laata aur growth rokta hai.

examples.title: Fruit ripening
examples.problem: Kaunsa hormone fruit ripening tez karta hai, aur commercially kaise diya jaata hai?
examples.solution: Ethylene; ethephon ke roop mein diya jaata hai jo plant tissues mein ethylene chhodta hai. Cucumbers mein female flowers bhi badhaata hai.

topics.title: Plasticity
topics.explain: Plants environment ya life ke phases ke hisaab se alag raaste lekar alag structures banate hain — jaise cotton, coriander aur larkspur mein heterophylly (juvenile aur mature plant mein alag leaves) aur buttercup mein (hawa aur paani mein alag leaves).

topics.title: Differentiation, dedifferentiation, redifferentiation
topics.explain: Meristems ke cells khaas kaam ke liye mature hote hain (differentiation). Living differentiated cells phir se divide karne ki kshamata paa sakte hain (dedifferentiation — jaise interfascicular cambium, cork cambium) aur phir aise cells banate hain jo phir divide karna chhod dete hain (redifferentiation).

topics.title: Conditions for growth
topics.explain: Paani (cell enlargement aur enzymatic activity ke liye), oxygen (metabolic energy ke liye), nutrients, aur sahi temperature aur light.

topics.title: Discovery of PGRs
topics.explain: Charles aur Francis Darwin ne coleoptiles ko light ki taraf mudte dekha (phototropism); F.W. Went ne Avena coleoptile tips se auxin nikaala; E. Kurosawa ne bakanae disease wale fungus se gibberellins; Skoog aur Miller ne kinetin; ABA inhibitor-B, abscisin II aur dormin ke naam se mila; Cousins ne paki oranges se ethylene confirm kiya.

topics.title: PGR interactions
topics.explain: Hormones saath kaam karte hain, kabhi synergistically kabhi antagonistically — jaise tissue culture mein auxin–cytokinin ratio root ya shoot banna tay karta hai; GA aur ABA ka seed dormancy par ulta asar hai.

topics.title: Seed germination
topics.explain: Achhi conditions mein seeds paani sokhte hain, enzymes active hote hain aur embryo seedling banta hai. Dormancy achhi conditions mein bhi germination rokti hai.

ratta: Arithmetic Lₜ = L₀ + rt;  geometric Wₜ = W₀eʳᵗ.
GA: bolting, grapes, sugarcane, malting;  delays FRUIT senescence.
Cytokinin: nutrient mobilisation → delays LEAF senescence;  lateral buds.
ABA: stomata close, dormancy, stress hormone.
